messages:
matt: Quick heads-up — PR #15321 (feat/db-schema-opts) is ready for final review but we're seeing a repeat failure in the Windows CI matrix. Need to land before Friday's deploy-freeze (2025-06-06). Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/15321
sophia: on it, prioritizing now. do we have repro steps for the windows flake?
jordan: I can try to repro locally in the windows container. saw `test_migrations::apply` timeout in the logs. copying the relevant snippet:```
E   TimeoutError: Migration apply exceeded 120s

Command: pytest tests/test_migrations.py::test_migrations_apply -k apply -q
```
matt: thanks. CI shows windows job hits the integration db startup more often under parallel runs. maybe increase wait/backoff?
carla: if we bump the migration test timeout from 120s -> 240s it's cheap, but i'd rather fix the race. are we ok with a temporary timeout bump to get this landed before freeze?
sophia: temporary bump sounds fine if we annotate the test and add a TODO. we should still open a follow-up issue to root cause.
release-coordinator: Reminder — freeze starts Fri 09:00 UTC. Any merges after 08:30 UTC need an exception. If you want a merge slot, request it here with ETA to merge and who will watch canaries.
matt: propose: bump test timeout + small rebase, request merge slot for Thu 18:00 UTC. i'll handle canary watch/rollback plan.
jordan: repro'd locally with `windows-runner:2025-05-22` image; increasing DB wait to 8s made test pass consistently. i'll push a tiny test change and CI rerun.
ci-bot: CI triggered for matt:pr/15321 — linux/py39 ✅, macos/py39 ✅, windows/py39 ⏳ (rerun requested by jordan)
sophia: i left review comments (small nits). approving pending the timeout annotation + changelog entry.
carla: approved as well — good to merge after timeout bump and a green windows job.
ci-bot: windows/py39 job passed ✅
matt: Thanks y'all. Slot request: Thu 18:00 UTC merge -> canary on staging for 30m, then prod rollout if no regressions. @release-coordinator can you reserve the slot?
release-coordinator: slot reserved Thu 18:00 UTC. please paste the exact merge command and rollback steps here 30m before.
matt: Will do. Merge command: `gh pr merge 15321 --squash --body "land feat/db-schema-opts"`
Rollback (if canary fails): revert via `git revert <merge-commit>` + hotfix pipeline `./scripts/hotfix-deploy --target prod` and notify #incidents.
sophia: thanks — i'll be on call for canary watch from 18:00-18:45 UTC. :thumbsup:
matt: great. last note: created follow-up issue #15402 to investigate migration DB startup timing and remove the expanded timeout within 2 weeks.
jordan: filing a small telemetry/trace for DB startup latencies in the test infra as part of that issue.
matt: closing out here — merging at the reserved slot unless any blockers pop up. :party_parrot:
